paragraphs.text: My dotfiles on macOS and Termux, managed with Chezmoi.
Hack my keyboard via Karabiner and maintain its config with Goku.
> Head over to nikitavoloboev's personal wiki to learn more about karabiner and goku.
Here are some settings (outdated, click to see)
My neovim config powered by LazyVim.

1. [x] Try NvChad, LazyVim, Kickstart, AstroNvim by Lazyman.
2. [ ] Find a set of keybindings that c

an be used everywhere, equivalent mapping configurations for other VIM integrations:
- IDE
- [ ] Ide

aVim
- [ ] VSCode Neovim
- [ ] Doom Emacs
- File manager
- [ ] Terminal: Yazi
- [ ] Neovim: neo-tree

.nvim
- [ ] VSCode: Built-in Explorer view
- [ ] IdeaVim: NERDTree
- Others
- [ ] fish_vi_key_bindin

1. Remap `esc`.
- For all keyboard (mainly for Apple Internal Keyboard): remap `jk` to `esc` by kara

biner.
- For Glove80 specifically: remap one of the **thumb keys** to `esc` by karabiner.
- In vim(s

): `inoremap jj <esc>` or `inoremap jk <esc>`.
2. Turn up `Key repeat rate` and turn down `Delay unt

il repeat` in `System Settings` -> `Keyboard`.
See .macos.
3. When leaving insert mode, auto switch

IME to English (if necessary).
- By Rime's vim_mode app option, see squirrel.custom.yaml.
- Use vim.

g.neovide_input_ime with `autocmd` in Neovide.
4. Remap `shift` (optional).
- For all keyboard: rema

p `space` to `shift` by karabiner.
> The original tap and hold (repeat) functions of `space` are sti

`shift` by karabiner.
> The original tap and hold (repeat) functions of `space` are still available.
My rime config for Chinese input based on TigerCode.
Using InputSourcePro to keep Squirrel as the only input source on macOS, instead of ABC.
And using ShowyEdge to notice when input source automatically changes to ABC.
Using emacs-rime in Doom Emacs and rime-ls in Neovim.

- [ ] Try AeroSpace.
- [ ] Try acsandmann/rift.
- [ ] Try karinushka/paneru.
Fix zathura auto focus on open problem by using yabai.
